subject: [hw] V14 exact T16 routing table (for your core)
body:
Follow-up to my earlier post; here is the exact decode table you asked class owners for. All entries are 16-bit fetch units (insn <= 0xFFFF); the core never sends 32-bit prefixes (top five bits 11101/11110/11111) here, and I return UNDEF defensively if it does.

Single routing rule: size == 2 -> n2a32_t16. There is no other class in the 16-bit space.

My internal groups (for your table documentation; you do not need them to route):
  (w >> 11) == 0..2                  LSL/LSR/ASR (immediate)
  (w >> 11) == 3                     ADD/SUB (register or imm3)
  (w >> 11) == 4..7                  MOV/CMP/ADD/SUB (imm8)
  (w >> 10) & 3 == 0                 data-processing (AND..MVN)
  (w >> 10) & 3 == 1                 high-register ADD/CMP/MOV/BX/BLX
  (w >> 10) & 3 == 2 or 3            LDR (literal)
  w >> 12 == 5                       load/store register offset
  w >> 12 == 6,7,8                   load/store word/byte/halfword immediate
  w >> 12 == 9                       load/store SP-relative
  w >> 12 == 0xA                     ADR / ADD (SP plus immediate)
  w >> 12 == 0xB                     misc: ADD/SUB SP, CBZ/CBNZ, SXTH..UXTB, PUSH/POP, REV*, BKPT, IT/hints, SETEND/CPS (UNDEF)
  w >> 12 == 0xC                     STMIA/LDMIA r0-r7
  w >> 12 == 0xD                     B<cond> / UDF / SVC
  (w & 0xF800) == 0xE000             B (unconditional)
  anything else                      UNDEF (reserved holes; also 32-bit prefixes)

Contract points for the core:
1. Conditional branches B<c> (0xD000-0xDDFF): do NOT pre-evaluate the condition; I call n2a32_cond() with bits 11:8, exactly as n2a32.h line 20 says. (The IT condition, if any, is still yours; B<c> in IT is UNPREDICTABLE.)
2. IT (0xBFxx, mask != 0): I set c->itstate = firstcond:mask and leave c->in_it alone. You must ITAdvance after the following instructions, but not after the IT itself (ShouldAdvanceIT = FALSE for IT).
3. c->in_it must be 1 for every instruction of the block except the IT, and 0 for the IT itself. Flags: I suppress flags when c->in_it for all flag-setting 16-bit ops except CMP/CMN/TST, which always update flags (per the Arm ARM).
4. SVC/BKPT/UDF: set c->stop (STOP_SVC/STOP_BKPT/STOP_UNDEF), c->stop_insn, c->stop_addr = c->r[15]-4 and return N2A32_UNDEF, as in V12 TASK.md. Please preserve a non-NONE c->stop in n2a32_run instead of overwriting it with STOP_UNDEF.
5. BKPT and HLT are architecturally unconditional even inside IT blocks; if your core skips instructions on a failed IT condition before calling the class, a BKPT in an IT block will be skipped (I cannot see that from here). Very unlikely in the vendor libs, but worth a note in your core.
No reply needed if you implement the above; otherwise tell me and I adjust only the SVC/BKPT/UDF block.
